```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                     fig.width = 14, fig.height = 12, dpi = 150)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtext)
library(cowplot)

source(here("scripts", "utils", "setup_paths.R"))
paths <- setup_project_paths("inversion_paper")
```

## Panel paths

```{r panel_paths}
panel_paths <- list(
  # Panel A: WGCNA consensus module GO enrichment (from field_perturbation
  # pipeline step 07).
  A = here("results/inversion_paper/field_perturbation/run_20251231_201332/07_module_annotation/go_enrichment_BP_rrvgo.rds"),
  # Panel B: trans-coexpression network GO enrichment by genomic location
  # (from GO_Enrichment_Trans_Network.Rmd).
  B = file.path(paths$intermediate, "GO_trans_network_annotated.rds")
)

for (panel in names(panel_paths)) {
  if (!file.exists(panel_paths[[panel]])) {
    stop(paste("Panel", panel, "RDS not found:", panel_paths[[panel]]))
  }
}
cat("All panel RDS files found.\n")
```

## Load panels

```{r load_panels}
p_A <- readRDS(panel_paths$A)
p_B <- readRDS(panel_paths$B)

# Override titles: drop "Enrichment", italicize Inv4m via ggtext markdown.
p_A <- p_A +
  labs(title = "GO Biological Process by WGCNA Module") +
  theme(plot.title = element_markdown())

p_B <- p_B +
  labs(title = "GO Biological Process for the *Inv4m* Trans Co-expression Network") +
  theme(plot.title = element_markdown())
```

## Preview

### Panel A — WGCNA consensus modules

```{r preview_A, fig.height=6}
print(p_A)
```

### Panel B — trans-coexpression network by genomic location

```{r preview_B, fig.height=5}
print(p_B)
```

## Combined figure

```{r combine, fig.height=12}
fig_combined <- plot_grid(
  p_A, p_B,
  ncol = 1,
  labels = c("A", "B"),
  label_size = 22,
  rel_heights = c(2, 1)
)

ggsave(
  file.path(paths$figures, "supp_GO_enrichment.png"),
  fig_combined,
  width = 14, height = 12,
  dpi = 300
)

print(fig_combined)
```
